name: no-secrets-in-code
description: Prevent hardcoded secrets, API keys, tokens, and passwords from being committed to the codebase
author: community
content:
## No Secrets in Code

NEVER hardcode secrets, API keys, tokens, passwords, or connection strings in source code.

### Rules
- Use environment variables for all secrets
- Use .env files (gitignored) for local development
- Use a secrets manager (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, etc.) in production
- Never log secret values, even partially
- Never include secrets in error messages
- Check for patterns: API_KEY=, SECRET=, PASSWORD=, TOKEN=, private_key
- Flag any string that looks like a base64-encoded key or JWT

### What to do instead
```
# Bad
const API_KEY = "sk-abc123...";

# Good
const API_KEY = process.env.API_KEY;
```
